design.matrix_law: 48 ordinary real-world domains crossed with 16 recurring communicative operations.
design.scoring_law: A if all direct requirements are lexically available; otherwise B if every unavailable required concept is resolved by a pre-existing architecture composition or a pre-frozen task route whose components recursively resolve; otherwise C.
design.safety_law: For a safety-critical task, every composed safety-relevant concept must have a pre-frozen semantic-equivalence status.
